SemanticAI.choose.title: Semantic Choice
SemanticAI.choose.comment: Classify text according to the instruction @{instruction} and output the selected option or abstain.

instruction.title: Instruction
instruction.tip: Describe the classification criteria; return abstain when the choice cannot be determined.

text.title: Text to Classify
text.tip: Enter text or reference text extracted from a web page.

options.title: Candidate List
options.tip: Reference a List variable. Each item must be a dictionary containing id and label; ids must be unique and cannot be __abstain__.

semantic_result.title: Semantic Choice Result
semantic_result.subTitle: AI Generated
semantic_result.tip: The dictionary contains status, selected_id, and confidence; network or service errors are handled as node errors.
